name: Dr Anish Garg
summary:
DM Nephrology–trained physician with strong experience in the comprehensive management of CKD,
ESKD, and AKI patients. Well-versed in dialysis therapies, transplant nephrology care, and inpatient
nephrology services. Committed to ethical, patient-centred, and protocol-driven nephrology practice.
EDUCATION: 3. MBBS — Manipal Academy of Higher Education (2013) [conf 0.95, review=False]
Achievements: PDSICON 2024: “Implementing a Peritoneal Dialysis Unit in a Resource-Limited Setting” —
2nd AVATAR India – Interventional Nephrology Congress Quiz Competition – Second Prize
